sandbachFocus: Sandbach United host Eccleshall at The Sandbach Community Football Centre in a fascinating 3rd v 4th clash. The hosts arrive on the back of a five-game unbeaten run (most recently a draw) and will be looking to capitalise on their home form, whilst fourth-placed Eccleshall bring a four-game winning streak into the encounter and will fancy their chances of causing an upset.
divisionWide: AFC Bridgnorth (1st) and Stafford Town (2nd) both sit on 19 points, level with Sandbach, making the title race extremely tight at the summit. Bilston Town face Market Drayton Town in a mid-table battle, while New Mills host struggling Dawley Town. Foley Meir entertain Widnes Town at Trentham Foods Stadium—Widnes remain rooted to the foot of the table with just 2 points. Crewe host Wednesfield Community in a clash between two lower-mid-table sides, and Shawbury United welcome Wolverhampton Casuals in another basement-area encounter. Brereton Social face title-chasing AFC Bridgnorth, while Telford Town travel to Barnton. At the other end, Allscott Heath host bottom-club Alsager Town—Allscott come into the game on the back of an impressive 7–1 away win, though Alsager's manager notes they face tough opposition throughout the league. Cheadle Heath Nomads take on second-placed Stafford Town at home.
